verdict: Organic activity is the only channel running; paid ads are off.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all lead and traffic activity came exclusively from your Google Business Profile — paid advertising on Meta and Google ran at $0 spend and produced zero leads. Your GBP delivered 89 total actions this period (18 calls, 30 direction requests, 41 website clicks), but that momentum is fading: GBP activity dropped 41% week over week, and the last three days of the period recorded just 1 action versus 12 in the three days prior. Instagram reach followed the same pattern, down 59% over that same short window. Paid campaigns are being brought back online to restore lead volume and provide the support organic-only traffic cannot sustain on its own.
